reason: The first eight proposals are the same 16-call panel32 wrapper experiment, so they are one hypothesis rather than distinct tests. It has a verified panel ABI and full-baseline correctness, but no performance result; fresh paired controls must decide whether the smaller packing footprint offsets repeated packing and SME transitions. B-panel packing has unresolved layout compatibility and adds a 1 MiB copy. Tail alignment affects only the general-size fallback, not the n=512 timed path. No supplied measurement establishes a gain or its cause.
